subject: c-fo-act
title: C.FO.ACT. ------ PRI.INFO.
description: Chart 1 of 3 on book p. 128 (AE(PD)-16). C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PRI-INFO (principle information) is the partner. From the subject: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) and MT-INFO (multi-information). From DYM-F: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From MT-INFO: PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance) and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From INT: LANG-DY (language dynamics). From LANG-DY: PART (participation) and POST (postulation), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of".
